schemes.title: Bhu Bharati — Telangana Land Records and Mutation
schemes.brief: Bhu Bharati is where a Telangana farmer sees the Record of Rights and the Pahani for their land, and applies for a mutation when land is sold or inherited. It replaces the older Dharani system under the Record of Rights Act, 2025, and all agricultural land services now run through it.
schemes.benefit: Record of Rights and Pahani online, with mutation, correction and pattadar passbook services
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Telangana and recorded in the Record of Rights
The applicant must be the recorded pattadar, or a legal heir, to apply for a mutation
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile, since every application is confirmed by OTP
Anyone may view a Record of Rights; only the holder can change one
documents: Registered sale deed, for a mutation on sale
Death certificate and legal heir certificate, for a mutation on succession
Survey number and khata number of the land

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: View Record of Rights, mutation on sale (Form V), mutation on succession (Form VI), correction, or pattadar passbook. Pick the one that fits what happened to the land.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the pattadar passbook or an old Pahani, including any letter at the end.

demoFields.label: Khata / Pattadar Account Number
demoFields.hint: Covers all your survey numbers in that one village, so it is the quicker way in if you hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Pattadar Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling first, then ask for a correction if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the person applying. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Relation to the recorded holder
demoFields.hint: For a succession mutation, state the relationship and attach the legal heir certificate and death certificate.

demoFields.label: Extent claimed (acres / guntas)
demoFields.hint: As on the passbook. A figure that does not match the record is the usual reason a mutation is held up.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the hearing notice and the final order all come here.

demoSteps: Open bhubharati.telangana.gov.in and view the Record of Rights and Pahani for your survey number. Check the extent, the pattadar name and the classification before you apply for anything.
Choose the service you need — Form V for a mutation after a sale, Form VI after a death in the family — and log in with Aadhaar and OTP.
Fill in the survey number, the extent and the parties, and upload the registered sale deed, or the death certificate and legal heir certificate.
Pay the fee online and keep the application number. Where a registration is involved, book the Sub-Registrar slot from the same system.
The Tahsildar examines it, and both sides may be called for a hearing where there is an objection. Attend, with the originals.
Once the order is passed, the Record of Rights is updated and a new pattadar passbook is issued. Download the updated record and check the extent and spelling at once.
Keep the updated Record of Rights with your papers. Rythu Bharosa, crop loans and farm subsidy applications are all matched against it.

schemes.title: TGPSC Recruitment — One Time Registration
schemes.brief: Every Telangana state government post advertised by the Public Service Commission — Group 1, 2, 3 and 4, engineering, lecturer and forest posts — is applied for through one profile called OTR. You build it once, and each notification afterwards takes only minutes. The commission was renamed from TSPSC to TGPSC, and the old addresses now redirect here.
schemes.benefit: One registration for every TGPSC notification, with hall tickets and results in the same place
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the notification, usually 18 to 44 with relaxation for SC, ST, BC and disability
The qualification the notification requires, held on its closing date
Local status in Telangana where the post is reserved for local candidates
One OTR profile per person; a second profile gets both cancelled
documents: Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marks memos
Caste certificate, for a reserved category
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Study certificates for Classes 4 to 10, to prove local status
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later certificate is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after the profile is made.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a certificate for. Age relaxation and fee concession both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Local Status (district)
demoFields.hint: Decided by where you studied Classes 4 to 10. Many posts are reserved for locals of a zone.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year of passing and marks. It must be complete on the notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: OTR Number (after registration)
demoFields.hint: Generated once and used for every application afterwards. Write it down.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every notification alert and the hall ticket link come here. Do not use a friend's number.

demoSteps: Open otr.tgpsc.gov.in and create the One Time Registration with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate. This is the part that cannot be freely corrected later.
Fill in education, category, local status and identity, upload the photograph and signature, and confirm the mobile OTP. Note down the OTR number.
When a notification you qualify for is out, open it from tgpsc.gov.in, log in with the OTR number, and apply — the profile fills most of the form.
Pay the application and examination fees online. SC, ST, BC, disabled, ex-servicemen and unemployed candidates are exempt from the examination fee on producing the certificate.
Keep the filled application printout and the payment receipt, and download the hall ticket about a week before the exam from the same login.
Results, answer keys and the selection list appear on the TGPSC site. Certificate verification follows the written stage, where the originals of everything you claimed must be produced.
Keep the OTR profile up to date. A qualification or category that is out of date on the closing date is treated as a false claim and the candidature is cancelled.
